text_block_list.text: I guess this is the end of summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm sorry for worrying you, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Kobe Shimbun Hai.
I'll make
sure to do my very best to
make it up to you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
With the way she smiles, I can tell that
she's
matured a lot this summer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
